extracted.name: 🥭 Mango 🥭 Float
extracted.description: One of my sis-in-law's fave, she always asked me to make this every weekend.
ingredient_lines: 2 pcs ripe mango, peeled and sliced thinly
1 small pack of all purposed cream
instruction_lines: Prepare all ingredients: jelly in 1 bowl, mix cream and condensed milk in other bowl, mango juice in another bowl.. slice the mango thinly
Dip biscuit in mango juice, then arrange in rectangular container, 2 to 3 layered or as desired.
Spread mango slice ove the biscuit, then scoop jelly and cream mixture.
Repeat procedure 2 and 3, until desired thickness.
Crush remaining biscuit, and sprinkle over the top of prepared mango float.. enjoy 😉
